Application Data.NAME: Optical Plus Services, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Optical Plus Services, Inc. specializes in the retail sale of optical frames, lenses, and accessories, providing high-quality products tailored to our customers' vision needs. Our operations include a full range of eyewear options, including private label products, with comprehensive customer service support, including in-house lens edging and minor frame repairs. We prioritize strict adherence to industry safety standards and maintain a documented customer recall program to ensure the highest level of patient care. Our inventory is well-managed, with a focus on loss prevention measures, employee training, and regular quality assurance protocols to safeguard our operations and customer satisfaction.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In the past three years, Optical Plus Services, Inc. experienced a theft incident on 06/20/2021 when a break-in resulted in the loss of inventory valued at $10,000. The claim was filed, and the status is closed following the reimbursement process. Additionally, there was water damage on 08/15/2022 due to a pipe burst, which incurred repair costs of $15,000. This claim is also closed. No ongoing losses or pending claims are reported.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras installed at all entry points, regular patrols by a licensed security firm, and an alarm system connected to a central monitoring station.
